steps.why: Generates the Prisma client (@prisma/client types) that the source imports; typecheck fails without it since install scripts were off.
The repo uses contentlayer/next-contentlayer; this generates the .contentlayer/generated types that code imports (contentlayer/generated) for tsc.
Generates the Prisma client from prisma/schema.prisma so tsc sees the model types. The typecheck runs without the generate that the build script does first.

Generates .contentlayer/generated, which the code imports from 'contentlayer/generated'. Only package.json is present there, and the generated output is otherwise only produced during next build or dev.

exclusion.reason: typecheck (tsc --noEmit) fails on the repo's own code: missing next-auth modules, Prisma client types out of sync with the schema (openaiKey, chatbotId), implicit anys and prop type mismatches. The build's P1001 database failure is a separate issue, but the typecheck errors are genuine code/type failures.
